stories.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
stories.body: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.

stories.title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims three years after deadly Hamas raid
stories.body: Memorial events have taken place in Israel on the third anniversary of the Hamas-led attack that sparked the devastating Gaza war.

stories.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
stories.body: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take any personal responsibility for what happened or order a state inquiry.

stories.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
stories.body: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

stories.title: Canada suspends plans to expand assisted dying to people with mental illness
stories.body: People with mental illness alone were to be eligible for assisted dying in Canada in March 2027, but that has now been paused indefinitely.

stories.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
stories.body: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

stories.title: Children killed while they slept as Russian missile kills 19 in block of flats
stories.body: Five children are among the victims of a strike that destroyed 30 flats in northern Ukraine as families slept.

stories.title: Sri Lanka's ex-first lady arrested over alleged misuse of children's hospital donations
stories.body: The 73-year-old has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations.

stories.title: Chinese runner dropped by sponsor after riding bike during marathon
stories.body: Sun Yuanyuan was seemingly pictured on the back of another person's bike during part of the Berlin Marathon.

stories.title: Chemistry Nobel awarded for solving mystery of life's asymmetry
stories.body: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.

stories.body: The patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, drove to Uganda and eventually flew to Kenya.

stories.title: Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
stories.body: Asahi, Kirin and Suntory confirmed their premises were searched by Japanese competition authorities.

stories.body: The convicted killer of Colleen Slemmer is said to be awake and speaking in hospital in Tennessee after an execution attempt.

stories.title: Many Nepalis swept away in the floods aren't officially dead, leaving families in limbo
stories.body: Relatives are finding themselves with no compensation and facing an administrative nightmare.

stories.title: The Republican candidates walking a Trump tightrope
stories.body: Some running in November's elections are deciding whether to distance themselves from an unpopular president who still dominates his party.
